originalFamilyScopeSummary: Audit and optimize deposit flow friction for unfunded Extension trade-screen users converting at 4.8% vs Mobile's 12.4%
currentTriggerSummary: pr-complete: feat(perps): investigate and improve deposit conversion for unfunded trade-screen users
notes: This run is the PR-completion pass over PR #45986, not a fresh implementation. The branch already carries the family's two executable acceptance criteria: funnel instrumentation across unfunded submit-click -> deposit_flow_opened -> deposit_confirmed -> trade_submitted_after_deposit (shared/constants/perps-events.ts, unfunded-deposit-funnel.ts, usePerpsDepositConfirmation.ts, perps-deposit-toast.tsx), and the shipped UI improvement (enabled 'Add funds to trade' primary CTA, hint under the summary, labeled Add funds control on the available-to-trade row). This run resolved all 11 CHANGES_REQUESTED findings from reviewer geositta, which were correctness defects in that instrumentation rather than scope gaps: unknown balance misclassified as a fundable zero, the funnel joining on a click rather than a confirmed deposit for the same address, deposit_confirmed double-counting, two disagreeing derivations of 'unfunded', an omitted has_perp_balance breaking the downstream join, and geo-blocked clicks escaping the funnel entirely. Recipe re-validation passed against branch + origin/main with a capture-helper screenshot of the live post-fix order form. The third family AC -- 'unfunded conversion is measurably improved against the 4.8% baseline' -- is a post-launch metric that cannot be verified pre-merge; the instrumentation needed to measure it is what this PR delivers. Mobile's combined 'trade with token' deposit+order flow remains explicitly out of scope per the ticket.
